meta_description: Primepipe Plumbing offers expert plumbing services across Nottingham. Fast response, honest pricing, and quality workmanship guaranteed. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Nottingham Plumbers — Fast, Reliable Callouts
hero_subhead: Leaks, boilers, or blocked drains — Primepipe Plumbing gets to you fast with honest pricing and no nasty surprises.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full bathroom installations, Primepipe Plumbing handles every plumbing need across Nottingham and the surrounding areas.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, sudden leaks, or no water — we respond quickly to plumbing emergencies across Nottingham to minimise damage and restore normality fast.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with our thorough servicing and repair work. We work on all major boiler makes and models.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: From full suite replacements to single fixture upgrades, we fit bathrooms to a high standard with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage over time. We locate and fix leaks accurately and efficiently, protecting your property and your wallet.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared quickly using professional-grade equipment. We leave your drains flowing freely and your home clean.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Full central heating installation, power flushing, radiator replacements, and system upgrades to keep your home warm throughout the colder months.

about_pullquote: We believe every customer deserves honest work, done properly, first time.
about_para_1: Primepipe Plumbing was founded with a straightforward goal: to provide Nottingham homeowners and businesses with reliable, fairly priced plumbing they can count on. Over the years we've built a strong local reputation by turning up when we say we will and completing every job to a standard we're proud of.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our commitment to transparency — you'll always know what a job will cost before we start, with no hidden charges or inflated callout fees. Our customers return to us time and again because they know they're getting a skilled, trustworthy tradesperson who respects their home.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Primepipe

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. I had a burst pipe on a Sunday morning and Primepipe were with me within the hour. Professional, tidy, and the price was very fair. Couldn't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Used Primepipe to fit a new bathroom suite and the result is stunning. They communicated well throughout, stuck to the agreed price, and left the place spotless. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Karen L.

reviews.text: Had a persistent leak under the kitchen sink that two other plumbers failed to sort. Primepipe found the cause straight away and fixed it properly. Refreshing to deal with someone who actually knows what they're doing.
reviews.author: Mark T.
